capabilities: Highlight Fountain syntax automatically in the editor
Enable Fountain per note via .fountain.md extension, fountain tag, or cssclasses property
Interleave Fountain with Markdown in the same note
Customize styling of every syntax token with exposed CSS variables
disambiguation: Not a full screenplay-writing or export tool; it only applies Fountain syntax highlighting and styling in the editor.
extras: Full documentation is hosted on an external wiki site (obsidian-fountain-editor.chuangcaleb.com), not in the README.
problem: Obsidian's editor does not recognize Fountain, the plaintext screenplay markup syntax, so screenplays look like unstyled text.

relations.evidence: You may also want to check out the similar Obsidian Fountain plugin!

summary: Fountain syntax highlighting plugin that styles screenplay-formatted Markdown notes inside the Obsidian editor.
